about_the_game:
In this pixel action shooting game inspired by the classic gameplay of Vampire Survivors, you will play as multiple heroines with unique backgrounds and skills, facing endless waves of shadow monsters. Choose the character that best matches your style, unleash chain skills, harvest Soul Embers, upgrade your powers, and fight to survive until dawn!

Key Features

Diverse Characters
Five distinct heroines, each with their own story, ultimate skill, and passive talents. From swift assassins to elemental sorceresses—pick your perfect battle companion.

Rich Skill Combos
Unlock over 20 active and passive skills. Bullet storms, traps, area explosions… freely combine them to create your ultimate soul-reaping arsenal!

Pixel Art Beauty
Retro pixel graphics blended with detailed lighting effects. Explore misty forests, abandoned cities, and underwater ruins for a post-apocalyptic fantasy experience.

Dynamic Upgrade System
Collect Soul Embers during battle to enhance weapons and skills, unlock hidden characters and potentials, and push your limits against tougher challenges.

Endless Survival Challenge
Randomly generated stages and enemy formations ensure every run is different. How long can you endure in the flames of doomsday?
